'''Jens''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] within [[Foxfire Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] attached to the [[Ividal Sector Forces]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jens flew with Foxfire Squadron during an [[Attack on Ongary IX|attack]] against the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the [[Planet|world]] [[Ongary IX]], and during the battle Jens flew as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of fellow pilot [[Jorn Kulish]]. The Z-95s of Foxfire Squadron were deployed as [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to fire [[burrowing plasma charge]]s against Separatist entrenched in fortified [[Mining/Legends|mine shafts]]. However, during their first bombing run, the [[Blast shield/Legends|blast visor]] of Jens' helmet was polarized by the flash from the detonation of the plasma warheads. While he tried to remove the helmet, Jens inadvertently flew his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the deck of a nearby [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

As a result of the difficulties faced by Jens and fellow pilot [[Rafana]] with flying during the flashes caused by firing the plasma warheads, during the later stages of the battle over Ongary IX the pilots of Foxfire Squadron were provided with [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]] on their helmets to protect their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from the explosions.
